description: List the apps owned by the authenticated developer, one short line each: id, name, slug, plan (its project's Pro, or free), projectId (the project it is in, neblla_projects), archived, files (how many the developer edits), updatedAt and pageUrl. For an app's configuration and state, call neblla_get_app with its id. `shared`: the apps of other developers whose team they are on (neblla_team), with their groups (`groups`; `access` is the first ready-made one: partner, support, viewer, screens or staff), whether in Business they see only their own (`own`) and what their groups, added up, let them do on each area (`can`: read | write | null), and `invitations` waiting for them to accept (in the panel, «Compartido contigo»). On a shared app, use the tools its groups allow; the rest answer not_allowed.
name: neblla_list_apps
